rationale: Price is consolidating tightly in a narrow range (~$14.79–$14.83) on very low per-candle volume after a large gap-up and intraday run from $13.71 to $15.32, now sitting at 72.7% of the day's range with 40 minutes to close. The tight consolidation without a defined breakout or breakdown structure, combined with today's existing realized loss, does not present a favorable risk/reward setup.
